name: Citizenship by Investment (CIP)

requirements.blocker_text: Non-refundable contribution of at least US$240,000 to the National Economic Fund for the main applicant with up to 3 dependents (additional dependent fees apply: $10,000 under 18, $20,000 over 18, $5,000 newborn).
requirements.fix_path: Make the qualifying National Economic Fund contribution.

requirements.blocker_text: Main applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Purchase of non-interest-bearing National Action Bonds for at least US$300,000 (any number of dependents), plus a US$50,000 non-refundable admin fee, held for 5 years from date of first issue.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase the qualifying bond and hold for 5 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Main applicant must be at least 18 years old.

Purchase of at least US$300,000 in an approved real estate project (high-end branded hotels, resorts, boutique properties), plus applicable administration fees ($30,000 solo, down to $10,000 per dependent for 4+ dependents).
requirements.fix_path: Purchase a qualifying share in an approved real estate project.

requirements.blocker_text: Main applicant must be at least 18 years old.

Minimum US$3,500,000 investment (solo) in an approved enterprise project (restaurants, marinas, agro-processing, pharmaceuticals, infrastructure, universities, housing, social development), plus a US$50,000 admin fee.
requirements.fix_path: Make the qualifying solo enterprise investment.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum US$6,000,000 combined investment in an approved enterprise project via joint venture, with a minimum of US$1,000,000 per applicant, plus a US$50,000 admin fee.
requirements.fix_path: Make the qualifying joint-venture enterprise investment.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum US$250,000 investment in an approved enterprise project under the dependents-inclusive tier, plus variable admin fees.
requirements.fix_path: Make the qualifying enterprise investment under this tier.

evidence_required.document: Application fee (US$2,000 main + US$1,000 per dependent)
Due diligence fee (US$8,000 main + US$5,000 per dependent 16+)

sources.title: CIP Saint Lucia (official government CBI program site) -- Citizenship by Investment: National Economic Fund ($240k), National Action Bond ($300k+$50k admin, 5yr hold), Real Estate Project ($300k+admin), Enterprise Project (solo $3.5M / joint $6M-$1M-each / with-dependents $250k), standard application/due-diligence fees

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Lucia's initial build. Six OR-groups model the full range of CIP investment options found on the official CIP Saint Lucia site, consistent with the Antigua CBI precedent of splitting multiple funding routes into separate OR-groups. Per-group age requirements set to hard: false (formality-only checks, same convention as prior CBI builds) so the route remains 'published' on the strength of its tier-1-sourced investment-amount hard requirements. Holding periods were not specified for the National Economic Fund or Real Estate Project options on this source (only the National Action Bond's 5-year hold is explicit) -- flagged as a gap rather than assumed to be zero.
